verdict.rationale: RustDesk's own llms.txt states that Server Pro adds a management API, so the product does document some public API. That is the only mention: it is a single line, limited to the paid Pro tier, and covers server management rather than driving sessions. Missing for 10: API reference documentation (endpoints, auth, scope), evidence that the API can drive the product itself beyond management, availability in the OSS edition, independent or hands-on corroboration of use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Server Pro adds a web console, device groups, a shared address book, per-user and device-group access control, audit logs, and a management API.
